[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
steady ticking woodblock clock ostinato on every beat
soft marimba playing even broken-chord eighth notes
music box melody, inquisitive phrases that end on a question
bassoon-like reed counter-melody answering the tune
intimate small-room interior, a workshop full of lenses and star-charts, thoughtful and absorbed
short warm room reverb, close and quiet
seamless transition back to the theme
